title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: architecture x biomorphism x water: the grown cathedral becomes a tiered FOUNTAIN. Keep the octagonal art-deco setbacks, fluted colonnades, mashrabiya/arabesque lattice screens, and ribbed-vault crown with gilded finials (cool stone / verdigris / gold-leaf), but bring the structure alive with water: luminous translucent cyan/white veils cascade over the lip of each setback tier (sheets over a weir) falling under gravity and re-emitting in a continuous loop; slow parabolic jets arc from the crown finial and tier corners; pooled water gently ripples in basins at each ledge and at the base. Ballistic gravity paths (no Perlin/curl noise); stone stays cool, the moving water glows cyan with foam highlights. ThoughtTrace signals drive patina, gilding, ornament density and water flow vigor. Slow, graceful motion; one slow camera drift; instantly reads as a built tiered fountain.
